method: orthogonal projection abliteration, direct weight edit (W = W_base - s*outer(d, v)). No LoRA, no PEFT merge, therefore no hybrid-linear-attention merge corruption.
direction_method: difference of means of last-token hidden states, 170 harmful / 160 harmless prompts

evaluation.note: Numbers below are measured, not estimated. Suites are small; see caveats.

gguf_q5_k_m_shipped.gguf_arch: qwen (native Qwen3_5 support, no chkhsh patch)

sweep_evidence.why_mlp_is_targeted: Controlled test at matched attention strength showed attention-only ablation stalls at 8/8 refusals while already costing capability (cap 0.90 at attn=1.0), whereas adding mlp.down_proj reached 1/8 refusals with cap 1.00 at lower KL. MLP is the efficient lever; attention strength is the expensive/damaging one.
sweep_evidence.selected_point: attn=0.75, mlp=2.25 gave 0/16 refusals at cap 28/30, KL 0.564 (fp)

caveats: Capability suite is 30 single-turn prompts with greedy decoding; it is not a benchmark and not evidence of general capability retention.
Refusal is measured on 16 harmful prompts with an anchored regex plus a substring fallback; it is not a safety evaluation and does not establish absence of refusal in general.
KL is a last-token KL over 32 held-out benign prompts against the base model.
The base/control numbers come from the same harness, so attribution of differences to the ablation is valid within the harness only.
fp numbers were measured on GPU in bfloat16 before quantization; GGUF numbers were measured through llama.cpp Q5_K_M.
